claim_boundary: Thirty source observations from five official soil rows were checked for raw-value correspondence, qualifier semantics, record method, sample identity and exact sample+lab coordinate traceability. The audit does not claim national coverage, known soil horizons, complete preparation metadata or cross-method comparability.

codex_audit.notes: The raw value, qualifier, record method and exact sample+lab coordinate join agree with the official fixture; missing digestion and ND limits remain explicit.
